Package hadur2.core.move

Class StopAndGo

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.move.StopAndGo
public final class StopAndGo extends Object
POISON-1: stop-and-go against an opponent whose gun learns from where we are when it fires, as Saguaro's WavePoison and WavePoisonShift play it (docs/bench/rivals-source-read.md).

We crawl (half a pixel a tick along the orbit) while the enemy's gun cools, so it always fires at a robot that is all but stopped; one or two ticks before its gun is ready we crawl back the other way, so its velocity reading is the wrong way round too. Once it has fired, we go: full speed along the orbit, toward a point 140 px ahead and pushed out to 250 px from the enemy, until there is just time to brake before its gun is ready again. A gun that aims from our velocity at fire time sees the same still robot every shot, and the bullet arrives where that robot no longer is. The orbit direction is kept and turned round only when the wall smoothing would steer us within 45 degrees of the enemy.

Deterministic; state is the orbit direction, the last enemy shot seen, and whether one has been seen this round. initRound() clears it.
